notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 advisory and support-switch surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies switch lifecycle accessors, ordinary declaration-relevance behavior, registration and interaction turn-on/turn-off callbacks, named update-rate callbacks, and active per-attribute update-rate queries without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador advisory and support-switch controls with FederateAmbassador relevance and update-rate callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador advisory-switch declarations and FederateAmbassador callbacks
